Contact

FAQ

Didn't find an answer? Give us a call.

Renting and booking

Can we rent just one apartment outside the season?

No. From September to June we always let the whole complex to one group. Individual apartments are only available in July and August.

How many people can stay?

29 people in fixed beds and another 8 on extra beds, 37 in total.

How does booking work?

Choose your dates in the booking system or call us. We send a confirmation and a deposit invoice for 50%, payable within 14 days. Once paid, the dates are yours.

What is the cancellation policy?

Cancelling more than 60 days before arrival is free. If you cancel later, the deposit is forfeited.

Is there a minimum stay?

The whole property is let for at least 2 nights.

Prices and fees

What's included in the price?

Accommodation in the whole complex, bed linen, towels, Finnish sauna, infrared sauna, relaxation room, hot tub, covered terrace, fire pit with firewood, darts, table football, 4 rowing boats with oars, Wi-Fi and parking. Pool from May to September.

What costs extra?

Cleaning and handover are added to the booking automatically. Electricity is charged by actual use (including heating and any EV charging) and the tourist tax per municipal rules. Extras such as the terrace kiosk can be added directly in the booking.

How much is the deposit?

CZK 5,000 to 10,000 depending on the length of stay, paid in cash on arrival. On departure we deduct electricity used (per meter reading), cleaning and any damage, and refund the rest.

What if we leave a big mess?

Standard cleaning is part of the booking. Exceptional mess is charged by actual time; the rate is in the terms and conditions.

Your stay

Where can we park?

Parking is free for 10 cars. 6 spaces are in the car park opposite the complex (just across the road), 2 below the terrace along the road and 2 in front of apartment no. 1. Caravans cannot be parked around the complex.

Can we charge an electric car?

Yes. There is a wallbox below the terrace and in front of apartment no. 1. Charging is included in the electricity bill.

Can we camp or bring a caravan?

No, camping and caravan parking are not allowed around the complex.

Can we fish in the reservoir?

Yes, with a valid fishing licence and a paid fishing permit from the anglers' association.

Can we borrow a boat?

Yes. Staying guests can use 4 rowing boats with oars for free. We recommend life jackets for children and non-swimmers.

Can we bring our own food and drink?

Yes. Apartments 1–4 have a kitchenette with crockery, so you can cook for yourselves. Apartment 5's common room has a cooker, fridge and a bar with a beer tap. There is a fire pit with a grill on the terrace. Bring your own bottled drinks at no charge. Beer and lemonade in kegs for our tap are supplied only by us. For bigger parties we can arrange catering, or you can add the terrace kiosk to your booking.

How late can we be noisy?

Please keep the noise down after 22:00; complete silence from midnight.

Can we bring a dog?

Yes, just let us know when booking. Dogs are free when renting the whole property; in summer in the apartments there is a fee shown in the booking. The complex is fully fenced.

Is the complex accessible?

A ramp leads into the complex, to the pool and onto the terrace. Apartment no. 1 is step-free; the others are up steps.

Is the pool open all year?

No, the pool is open from May to September.

Is the pool safe for small children?

The pool is not fenced. It has a sliding cover, which we recommend keeping closed whenever nobody is swimming so that no small child or animal can fall in. When the cover is open, an adult must supervise the pool at all times.

Do you have a cot?

Yes, add it directly when booking.

Is there an iron in the apartment?

Yes, every apartment has an iron, ironing board and clothes airer.

Is the complex suitable for a company event?

Yes. There is a projector that shows on the wall behind the stage, a flipchart and Wi-Fi. We issue invoices to companies. All prices on the website include VAT.

Do prices include VAT?

Yes, all prices on the website include VAT.

Is the road passable in winter?

In winter the access road can be difficult. Please call us the day before arrival on +420 775 704 669 and we will tell you the current conditions and advise you.

Are there cameras on site?

The outdoor areas are monitored for safety. We only review recordings if a problem occurs.

What if we forget something?

The vending machine on the terrace has drinks, sweets and items like chargers, plasters and hand cream.
